name: isocan
description: The isocan canvas bound to your workspace, in a pane beside the chat and without a second chat column. New conversations join the canvas under their own names and hear its mentions; the pane runs canvas skills, fans an ask out across model tiers, and enrols model-pinned standing agents.
suggestedPrompts: Open the isocan canvas for this workspace and tell me what is on it
Put the screen we just built on the canvas so the team can comment on it
Build the selected canvas screen as real code in this repo
Help me answer the questions agents left for me on the canvas
Which canvas skills can I run here? (isocan command ls)
